'''Lorwyn Kilvar''' is the son of the mayor of [[Ostin Falls]].

== History ==
The Kilvars descend from a [[Domani]] merchant house, and have ruled the town of Ostin Falls on the border of [[Toman Head]] and [[Almoth Plain]] for around fifty years by {{ne|998}}. The town begins to decline with the hostilities between [[Tarabon]] and [[Arad Doman]] reducing trade in the region, which was exacerbated by the [[Seanchan]] occupation of [[Falme]]. 

Desperate to save the town from economic ruin or destruction, Mayor [[Bretton Kilvar]] arranged a marriage between his son and [[Meka Antos]], the daughter of a merchant family from [[Bandar Eban]]. Lorwyn did not want to be married to Meka, and frequented [[Sean's Tale]] hoping that he would find a group to take him to [[Toman Head]] to see what was going on in the area. After a skirmish with [[Whitecloaks]] in [[Aturo's Orchard]], guards from House Antos apprehended Lorwyn and had him return to his family.<ref name="RPG">''[[The Wheel of Time Roleplaying Game]]''</ref>
